say:10:1622533007:1.text: *Sigh* Years ago, something dark took hold of me. It twisted my mind until I lost myself, and I lashed out without knowing who or what I was striking.
say:10:1622533007:1.source_cn: 唉……许多年前，我受到了某种黑暗力量的侵蚀腐化，神志常...

say:11:1622533008:1.text: Perri tended to me every day... It helped, slowly. One day, after he finished treating me, I fell into a deep sleep.
say:11:1622533008:1.source_cn: 皮瑞他……他一直在治疗我，我的状况在慢慢好转。有一次治...

say:12:1622533009:1.text: When I woke... I saw him lying there, lifeless. And the scent of corruption on him... it was the same as mine. I knew it instantly.
say:12:1622533009:1.source_cn: 等我醒来时，我在森林里看到了……看到了皮瑞的尸体。他的...

say:13:1622533010:1.text: <style="highlight">I thought I had struck him down in my madness</style>... <style="highlight">I never received his letter</style>... so all these years, I kept believing I had taken my only friend from this world...

say:15:1622533011:1.text: The guilt wrapped around me like a vine. And as the corruption grew, my mind only slipped further away...

say:16:1622533012:1.text: <style="highlight">Anyone who set foot in the forest... I saw them as carriers of the corruption. I called to them, drew them closer, and... took their lives.</style>

say:17:1622533013:1.text: Other times, I thought they were Perri. I wanted to keep them here forever so he wouldn't leave me again...
say:17:1622533013:1.source_cn: 有时候，我又会把他们当作皮瑞，想把他们永远留在森林里……

say:18:1622533014:1.text: Once, a human burned away part of the corruption on my body. He was looking for a friend's lost cat. For a moment, the pain cleared my mind... and it reminded me of Perri, of the kindness he showed me...

say:19:1622533015:1.text: I managed to let that man go, but only that once. Most days, I had no control over myself...
say:19:1622533015:1.source_cn: 我放走了他，但大多数时候我都控制不住自己……

choice_prompt:20:1622533015.text: I managed to let that man go, but only that once. Most days, I had no control over myself...
